problems.final_proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmem₁ : r₁ ∈ Ideal.span {r₂} := by
      rw [← h]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    have hmem₂ : r₂ ∈ Ideal.span {r₁} := by
      rw [h]
      exact Ideal.subset_span (by simp)
    by_cases hr₂ : r₂ = 0
    · have hr₁ : r₁ = 0 := by
        rw [hr₂] at hmem₁
        rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem₁
        rcases hmem₁ with ⟨c, hc⟩
        simpa using hc
      refine ⟨1, isUnit_one, ?_⟩
      rw [hr₁, hr₂]
      simp
    · rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton] at hmem₁ hmem₂
      rcases hmem₁ with ⟨c, hc⟩
      rcases hmem₂ with ⟨d, hd⟩
      have hcd : c * d = 1 := by
        apply mul_left_cancel₀ hr₂
        calc
          r₂ * (c * d) = (r₂ * c) * d := by ring
          _ = r₁ * d := by rw [← hc]
          _ = r₂ := by rw [← hd]
          _ = r₂ * 1 := by rw [mul_one]
      have hcunit : IsUnit c := by
        refine ⟨⟨c, d, hcd, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [mul_comm, hcd]
      refine ⟨c, hcunit, ?_⟩
      calc
        r₁ = r₂ * c := hc
        _ = c * r₂ := by rw [mul_comm]
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    ext x
    rw [Ideal.mem_span_singleton, Ideal.mem_span_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      refine ⟨u * c, ?_⟩
      rw [hc]
      ring
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      rcases hu with ⟨v, hv⟩
      have hu_eq : u = ↑v := by rw [hv]
      rw [hu_eq]
      refine ⟨↑(v⁻¹) * c, ?_⟩
      rw [hc]
      calc
        r₂ * c = (↑v * ↑(v⁻¹)) * (r₂ * c) := by rw [Units.mul_inv, one_mul]
        _ = (↑v * r₂) * (↑(v⁻¹) * c) := by ring
